name: an event that already exists is never added or edited again; a reminder wish becomes a real reminder preview
incident: Live failure of 2026-11-19 (incident F, ADR 0015): the calendar already had 'Çöpü çıkar' today 07:30-07:45 with a 30 min reminder. The owner wrote that they will take the trash out at 7:30 and asked to be reminded. The bot previewed an edit with identical before and after, the owner asked what the difference was, and after 'evet' it wrote a no-op. Now: 'Zaten takvimde', nothing is written, and a reminder wish is offered as a real reminder change.
